# ACM FAccT Conference

> The premier international conference on fairness, accountability, and transparency in computing systems, featuring research presentations, workshops, and community engagement.

ACM FAccT is an annual conference bringing together researchers, practitioners, and policymakers to discuss ethical and responsible AI and algorithmic systems. The conference includes peer-reviewed research papers, tutorials, doctoral colloquia, and community-led initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT)
- Algorithmic Fairness
- AI Ethics
- Peer Review Process
- Call for Papers
- Doctoral Colloquium
- CRAFT Proposals
- Conference Program
- Keynote Speakers
- Author Guidelines
- Reviewer Guidelines
- Area Chairs
- Academic Submissions
- Conference Schedule
- Community Engagement

- [2026 Call for Tutorials](https://facctconference.org/2026/cft.html): Invitation for tutorial proposals and submissions for 2026
- [2026 Doctoral Colloquium Applications](https://facctconference.org/2026/callfordc.html): Application process for PhD students to participate in the doctoral colloquium
- [2026 CRAFT Proposals](https://facctconference.org/2026/cfpcraft.html): Call for CRAFT proposals for 2025 conference submissions

- [2026 Call for Volunteers](https://facctconference.org/2026/callforvolunteers.html): Recruitment for volunteers to support conference organization
